title: Human medial temporal lobe iEEG during a visual working memory task (Boran et al.; DANDI 000575)
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from medial temporal lobe depth electrodes (amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal and parahippocampal cortex) in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual working memory change-detection task with set sizes of 1, 2, 4 or 6 items. The dataset is a BIDS-iEEG conversion of the continuous iEEG series released in NWB format on DANDI (000575), with corrected sampling rates, amplitude units, event tables and MNI electrode coordinates. It covers 11 participants, 12 sessions and 13 recordings.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Neuralynx ATLAS system at the University Hospital Zurich while patients with invasive monitoring performed a change-detection task (encoding 0.8 s, retention 0.9 s, probe 2 s; about 192 trials per session). NWB files were converted to BrainVision float32 microvolt format without filtering, resampling or re-referencing. Sampling rates were verified using the 50 Hz mains peak and coverage of trial times.
